questions.title: Is it an established business or a new business (startup)?
questions.description: This helps us understand your stage, risk profile, and the kind of partnership that usually works best.

options.label: New business (startup)
options.description: You're launching something new—often pre-revenue or early stage. Choose this if you're validating an idea, building an MVP, or scaling from zero.

options.label: Established business
options.description: Your company already operates with customers, revenue, or internal teams. Choose this if software should support or grow what you already do.

questions.title: Do you have funding?
questions.description: Funding affects how fast you can move, team size, and whether a partnership model like Betacode Ventures makes sense.

options.label: Yes
options.description: You've raised capital or have a dedicated budget for product development. We can plan a fuller team and a clear delivery timeline.

options.label: No
options.description: You're bootstrapping or still securing investment. We'll lean toward cost-efficient builds or equity partnerships to get you started.

questions.title: How big is your company?
questions.description: Company size helps us gauge complexity, compliance needs, and whether you need a full team or targeted support.

options.label: 1–10 employees
options.description: Small team or founder-led. Often needs a dedicated external tech partner or a focused MVP build.

options.label: 11–50 employees
options.description: Growing company with evolving needs. Often a mix of dedicated team and flexible augmentation.

options.label: 51–200 employees
options.description: Mid-size organization. Usually balances internal capability with specialists for specific projects.

options.label: 200+ employees
options.description: Large organization. Often needs augmentation, migrations, or expert support at scale alongside internal teams.

questions.title: Do you have a tech team?
questions.description: Knowing whether you have in-house technical people changes whether we embed with your team or become your tech department.

options.label: Yes
options.description: You have developers, engineers, or a technical lead. Augmentation, consulting, and targeted support often fit best.

options.label: No
options.description: Technology isn't your core strength yet. A dedicated external team or full-service build is usually the right starting point.

questions.title: What kind of product or help do you need?
questions.description: Pick what you're trying to achieve right now. We'll combine this with your funding situation to recommend the right services.

options.label: Develop an MVP
options.description: Ship a first working version in months—not years. Ideal when you need to validate your idea with real users quickly.

options.label: Create a tech team
options.description: Build a dedicated team that owns your product long-term—a self-managed team we set up and run for you.

options.label: Technical support
options.description: Scoped help: integrations, bug fixes, scripts, or maintenance on something you already have.

options.label: I don't know — help me decide
options.description: We'll recommend based on your funding and goals—not just the type of project.

questions.title: What kind of product or help do you need?
questions.description: Pick the option closest to your main goal. We'll factor in whether you have a tech team when suggesting services.

options.label: Developing a new product
options.description: Build something new—a SaaS platform, customer portal, internal tool, or mobile-first product from scratch.

options.label: Modernize old application
options.description: Upgrade legacy software: improve UX, refactor code, replatform, or move to a modern stack without a risky big-bang rewrite.

options.label: Team augmentation (outsourcing)
options.description: Add developers, product owners, or specialists to your existing team—flexible capacity on your roadmap and processes.

options.label: Technical support
options.description: Short, scoped work: API integrations, bug fixes, scripts, or maintenance—without a long-term team commitment.

options.label: I don't know — help me decide
options.description: We'll recommend based on your company size, tech team, and goals.

questions.title: Talk a bit about your product
questions.description: Optional—but the more context you share, the more accurate our recommendation. Mention your industry, users, timeline, or tech stack if you know it.
questions.placeholder: E.g. We're a logistics company building a customer portal. We need integrations with our ERP and a mobile-friendly UI by Q3...

contact.title: Talk to us
contact.description: Share your name and email so we can follow up with a tailored proposal. Website is optional.

fields.label: Company or project website
fields.description: Helps us understand your brand, product, and market before the call.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: So we know who to address when we reach out.

fields.label: Email
fields.description: We'll use this to send your estimate summary and schedule a follow-up.
